verdict.rationale: The evidence shows recurring and scheduled charges and webhooks only for card-present payments. Nothing documents failed-payment events for online or recurring charges, automated or API-driven retries, or dunning outreach. Recurring billing and card-present webhooks are adjacent features and do not deliver this story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor failed payments via API and webhooks and drive retries and dunning outreach
